Callout.Name: High Risk Escort
Callout.Message: Escort required for a high-risk transfer.
Callout.Advisory: Transfer waiting on you, route already cleared.

Script.Line: The transfer is at four and it has to be a two unit escort.
He has previous for going for the door on the highway.
If you are not happy with the route we go the long way. I would rather be late.

Lines.Approach: They will not move until you are with them. It is a straight run and they want it done quietly.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
